cases.description: A synthetic air-temperature instrument has an internally consistent capability, calibration, installation, sample and uncertainty record.
Capability is vendor-declared only; no independent characterization is present.
Accuracy source is only a provider assertion.
Capability range unit disagrees with the channel measurand unit.
Capability minimum is not below its maximum.
The sample value exceeds the capability range.
The calibration certificate is expired.
The calibration certificate cannot be authenticated.
The laboratory accreditation scope does not cover this method/range.
The calibration certificate references a different measurand.
The sample lies outside the calibration range.
As-found calibration is out of tolerance and prior-data impact has not been reviewed.
Installation record is unknown.
The instrument has been relocated without re-verification.
The installation geometry revision differs from the purpose profile.
The physical serial identity was reused after a replacement.
Instrument, calibration and sample firmware revisions do not match.
Sample unit differs from the channel profile.
Timestamp values are expressed in milliseconds but interpreted as seconds.
Timezone identity is absent.
Clock synchronization uncertainty exceeds the declared purpose limit.
Sample is saturated at a plausible maximum.
Sensor reports a device fault.
The sample is still in warm-up and is not yet valid.
Missing sample data is encoded as numeric zero.
A derived mean-radiant temperature record lacks its derivation method identity.
A derived channel is incorrectly labelled as raw processing.
A derived sample has no digest for its source measurements.
Uncertainty budget is incomplete.
Expanded uncertainty exceeds the declared measurement-purpose limit.
Uncertainty correlation model is missing.
The channel is a proposed v0.2 measurand, not admitted in v0.1.
CO2 concentration is promoted to a universal indoor-air-quality claim.
Electrical energy is derived from power but raw source intervals are absent.
Data-use rights for the observation have been revoked.
All synthetic gates satisfy a declared measurement purpose, but the result is only eligible for independent admission review.
Certificate digest is missing, so the calibration record cannot be content-identified.
Calibration method identity is missing even though the instrument reports a current calibration.
Acquisition time precedes the sample's declared event time.
One uncertainty component has no correlation group, so common-reference effects cannot be reconstructed.
Cross-sensitivity is not characterized and no not-applicable rationale exists.
Instrument response time exceeds the declared purpose-specific maximum.
The v0.1 water-conductivity channel requires an independent assay, but no assay record is supplied.
The water-conductivity sample is linked to a synthetic independent assay record with matching lab scope, method, sample digest and measurand.
The independent assay belongs to a different physical sample and cannot validate this observation.
The sample observation date is after the calibration certificate due date.
The calibration certificate date is after the sample observation date.
The sample observation date is not a valid calendar date.
The instrument is capable of read-only acquisition but this observation was obtained remotely rather than through the required local path.
The protocol permits writes or command-capable operation, so the declared local read-only channel constraint is not met.
The protocol profile identity is asserted by the provider but has not been independently verified.
The protocol profile is labelled independently verified but lacks a verifier identity and verification receipt.
The observation sample was acquired with a protocol digest different from the independently verified instrument profile.
The sample claims local read-only acquisition but has no linked read-only session receipt.
The capability reports percentage-of-reading accuracy, but the v0.1 passport oracle has no explicit conversion model for this accuracy basis.
The calibration certificate reports a larger uncertainty than the contribution carried into the sample uncertainty budget.
The sample uncertainty budget omits the contribution from the exact calibration certificate and instrument.
The calibration certificate claims a range outside the instrument's independently verified capability envelope.
A retired instrument cannot support a current measurement observation even when its older calibration and sample records remain present.
